clips.title: The story
paras: Tarrel Rockweaver is an anxious dwarven husband stationed on the bridge leading into Menethil Harbor. Deeply worried for his wife Merrin, an archaeologist who ventured inland with Whelgar's excavation team, he watches the road hoping for news of her safety.

While trade and military shipments flow through Menethil Harbor, Tarrel Rockweaver keeps an anxious vigil at the bridge on the edge of town. His wife, Merrin Rockweaver, joined Prospector Whelgar's prestigious archaeological expedition deeper into the Wetlands. When violent raptors overran the excavation site and cut off regular communication, Tarrel was left stranded in town, begging passing travelers to scout east toward Whelgar's Excavation Site to ensure she survived the disaster.
